keyPoints: Vigyaan ka matlab hai sawal puchhna, dhyan se dekhna aur saboot ke saath samajhna — ye koi ratne wala vishay nahi hai, balki duniya ko samajhne ka ek khaas tareeka hai jo har bachcha apna sakta hai.

Har cheez ko vigyaanik nazar se dekhne ke liye pehle saaf-suthra nirikshan (observation) karna padta hai, phir uspar gehara sawal uthana padta hai; jaise patte hare kyun hote hain ya barish ke baad mitti se khushboo kyun aati hai.

Ek achha sawal wo hai jiska jawab prayog ya nirikshan se mil sake, jaise paudhe suraj ki taraf kyun jhukte hain; aise sawal humein khoj ki raah par le jaate hain aur naye gyaan ke darwaze kholte hain.
Parikalpana (hypothesis) matlab sambhavit jawab, jise chhote prayog se jaancha ja sakta hai; agar parikalpana galat nikle to use badal dena bhi vigyaan ka hissa hai.
Vigyaan me galti karna bura nahi hai — har galat jawab humein sahi jawab ke aur kareeb le jaata hai, isiliye bade vaigyanik apni galtiyon se seekhkar aage badhte hain.
Vigyaan ka kaam akele nahi hota; milkar kaam karne, charcha karne aur nateeje imaandaari se likhne se gyaan badhta hai aur doosre bhi usse seekh paate hain.
Aam galti: vigyaan ko sirf kitabi paribhashaen yaad karna; asal vigyaan sawal puchhne, dhyan se dekhne aur khud chhote prayog karke dekhne me hai.

title: Vigyaan ki Adbhut Duniya
